title: $100 a month into Netflix since 2002 is now worth this
caption:
$100 every month into Netflix since 2002.
Today that would be worth about {dca:NFLX:2002-05-23} (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: Could you put away $100 a month? 👇
sources: Netflix price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: One hundred dollars a month, into Netflix, starting in 2002.
Back then, Netflix was mailing DVDs.
Today, those monthly payments would be worth about {dca:NFLX:2002-05-23}.
Small, boring, every month. That's how wealth is built.
